text:
incident-bot: [AutoAlert] Incident INC-2026-782 opened — cont-batch KV-cache memory rising abnormally in us-west-2. Severity: P2. Trigger: cont-batch-kv-used > 80% for 3m. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-782

alex: saw first signs at ~12:11 PDT. p50 fine, p99 jump from ~70ms -> ~2.7s. Some 502/504s reported.

maya: confirming OOMs logged on cont-batch-4, cont-batch-9 around 12:12. Pager alerts from oncall.

jordan: I pushed a clusterwide change last night to increase max_num_seqs from 8 -> 28 to help throughput for long-embed jobs. timeline fits.

alex: long seq clients + higher max_num_seqs -> giant batch_tokens. KV cache eviction thrash, IO paging, then process restarts.

alex: logs snippet:
```
E 12:12:08 cont_batch_scheduler.cpp:430 oversized_batch: computed batch_tokens=120384, max_batch_tokens=65536
W 12:12:09 kv_cache.cpp:298 evicting 450MB entries due to pressure
E 12:12:11 memmon: process_restart: container restarted (oom_kill) pid=1423
```

maya: impact: internal metrics show ~1.3k user requests with elevated latency, ~90 timed out. customer-ops, any customer reports?

customer-ops: ACME and NovaSight reported spikes in failures. ACME ticket created CS-7921. They saw ~150 failed responses between 12:10-12:18. They called support.

jordan: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporary global downgrade of max_num_seqs, 2) set conservative max_batch_tokens, 3) flip enable_continuous=false for affected model shard. Which to do first?

alex: do (2) + (3) now. (2) cheapest and lowest risk. also rate-limit very long seq clients.

maya: I'll run a hot-patch to set max_batch_tokens=32768 and max_num_seqs=10 and disable continuous for the high-latency shard. Commands I intend to run:
```bash
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/cont-batch-config MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=32768 MAX_NUM_SEQS=10 ENABLE_CONTINUOUS=false --record
# then force rolling restart of cont-batch pods on shard-3
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/cont-batch-shard-3
```

deploy-bot: Hotpatch job started. Canaries deployed to shard-3 (1/3 pods).

ops-bot: Note: setting ENABLE_CONTINUOUS=false will route those requests to the standard batch path; expect throughput drop ~15-25%.

alex: will also apply per-client seq gating for clients with median seq > 8: /admin/client-gate?client=ACME&max_seq=4096. Doing it now.

alex: hotpatch applied to shard-3 and shard-7, rolling to remaining shards. Observing metrics...

maya: KV-cache usage dropping: from 88% -> 53% in 3m. OOMs stopped, p99 down to ~210ms on patched shards.

customer-ops: ACME confirms errors reduced after 12:18, they see normal traffic now. Will keep ticket open.

jordan: good. we should keep continuous disabled for this model until we implement sequence-length gating and dynamic batch token caps. Filing follow-up tasks: RUM-1423 (gating), RUM-1424 (auto batch token cap), OPS-3142 (runbook).

jessica: I'll take action items for gating in the runtime: add per-request seq_len header check, pre-filter requests that would push batch_tokens past threshold. Also implementing a safety fallback that rejects cont-batch if computed_batch_tokens > 65536 with clear error code.

maya: handing off on-call to jessica for the next 8 hours to own postmortem + customer comms. I'll stay available.

alex: drafting incident summary: root cause = misconfigured default max_num_seqs promoted to prod without seq-length telemetry; combined with sporadic long-seq traffic causing oversized batches -> KV cache thrash -> paging -> OOMs/timeouts. Mitigation = hotpatch reduced max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs, disabled continuous for impacted shard, applied per-client gating and notified customers.

maya: timeline note: detection 12:11 -> mitigation rolled at 12:16 -> customer impact reduced by 12:18. total affected ~1.3k requests, ~90 failed/timeout.

incident-bot: INC-2026-782 status updated -> mitigated at 12:20 PDT.

jordan: post-incident next steps (short):
- revert any broad increases to max_num_seqs until gating is in place
- add deploy check to require seq-length histograms for config changes increasing max_num_seqs
- add alert: cont-batch batch_tokens per-shard > 50k for 2m

jessica: acknowledged, will own RFC + PR for gating and the new alert. assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime.

maya: handing off to jessica, signing off on mitigation. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks team. closing the loop once RCA posted. :thumbsup:
